title: Parades and Fireworks
intro: [excited] Welcome in to Disney Jeopardy! Grab your spot on the curb early, because tonight is all about parades, fireworks, and nighttime spectaculars. [whispers] The lights are dimming... [dramatic pause] and it's SHOWTIME.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a nighttime parade of glowing floats covered in thousands of twinkling lights rolling down a Victorian main street while huge colorful fireworks burst over a fairytale castle

categories.title: I See the Light
categories.intro: Our film category features the most beautiful lantern scene in Disney history... [sighs] I get chills. It's 2010's Tangled. Let your hair down!

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: thousands of glowing golden floating lanterns over a lake at night beside a medieval island kingdom, a small rowboat on the water

clues.clue: What kind of animal is Rapunzel's little sidekick Pascal?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a chameleon. [laughs] Pascal changes color to hide, but he can NEVER hide that attitude.

clues.clue: What household item does Rapunzel use as her weapon of choice?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a frying pan. Frying pans, who knew, right? Flynn certainly didn't.

clues.clue: What is the real name of the thief who calls himself Flynn Rider?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Eugene Fitzherbert. [chuckles] Not quite as dashing as Flynn Rider, but unlike the wanted posters, his nose is perfect.

clues.clue: What is the name of the pub where Rapunzel learns that even ruffians have dreams?
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is the Snuggly Duckling. [mischievously] Hook Hand wanted to be a concert pianist. We love a dreamer.

clues.clue: The kingdom releases lanterns every year on the lost princess's birthday. How old does Rapunzel turn in the film?
clues.reveal: [gasps] Oh, this one is TOUGH. The correct answer is... 18. Eighteen years of lanterns, and she finally got to see them up close. [sniffles] Cue happy tears.

categories.title: Light Up the Sky
categories.intro: [excited] Fireworks and nighttime spectaculars, in PICTURES! Ooh and aah as you answer. [chuckles] I'll be listening for the ooh.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: brilliant fireworks exploding over a lagoon with colorful water fountains and glowing reflections, night sky full of sparkles

clues.clue: Before many Disney fireworks shows, which tiny pixie flies down from the top of the castle?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Tinker Bell. [laughs] She has been flying over the castle since the 1960s, and she's never once missed her mark.

clues.clue: Which Disneyland nighttime show on the Rivers of America has Mickey battling villains with water, fire, and his imagination?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fantasmic! Some imagination, huh? Mickey versus a giant dragon is never a fair fight for the dragon.

clues.clue: World of Color lights up Paradise Bay with water fountains at which park?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Disney California Adventure. [laughs] Stand in the splash zone at your own risk. You have been warned.

clues.clue: Which Magic Kingdom fireworks show debuted in 2017, was replaced by Disney Enchantment in 2021, and made a triumphant return in 2023?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Happily Ever After. Disney fans begged and begged, and their wish came true.

clues.clue: Epcot's long-running nighttime show IllumiNations: Reflections of Earth took its final bow in what year?
clues.reveal: [whispers] Only the true Disney nerds got this one. The correct answer is... 2019. [chuckles] After about twenty years over World Showcase Lagoon, that giant Earth globe finally rested.

categories.title: Parade Palettes
categories.intro: Color Palettes are BACK! These are the outfit colors of characters you'd see in a Disney parade. [dramatic pause] Name the character.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: an artist's palette with bold paint swatches beside a parade float covered in glittering lights and confetti

clues.clue: These are the colors of which character's classic parade look?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ariel. [mischievously] Green tail, purple seashells, and that famous red hair. You can spot her float from a mile away.

clues.clue: These are the colors of which character's classic parade look?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Donald Duck. A sailor shirt and hat, but famously, no pants. Classic Donald.

clues.clue: These are the colors of which character's classic parade look?
accept: belle from beauty and the beast
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Belle. [laughs] That golden ball gown is one of the most iconic dresses in animation.

clues.clue: These are the colors of which character's classic parade look?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Snow White. Blue bodice, yellow skirt, red bow, and the original Disney princess.

clues.clue: These are the colors of which character's classic parade look?
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] And the correct answer is... Goofy. [laughs] Orange turtleneck, black vest, blue pants, and that floppy green hat. Ah-hyuck!

categories.title: Parade Route
categories.intro: Let's head to Main Street and grab a curb spot. [whispers] Don't let anyone take it. This category is all about Disney parades, past and present.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a nighttime parade float shaped like a glowing dragon rolling down a crowd-free Victorian main street, strings of twinkling lights

clues.clue: Which famous nighttime parade, covered in thousands of twinkling lights, debuted at Disneyland in 1972?
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is the Main Street Electrical Parade. Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls! You know the rest.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's Festival of Fantasy Parade features a fire-breathing dragon from which film?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sleeping Beauty. [chuckles] It's Maleficent, in her full steampunk dragon form, breathing real fire.

clues.clue: The Paint the Night parade, with its glowing floats, first debuted at which park in 2014?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Hong Kong Disneyland. [mischievously] It came to Disneyland a year later for the 60th anniversary.

clues.clue: What is the name of the bouncy electronic theme song of the Main Street Electrical Parade?
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is... Baroque Hoedown. Beep boop boop beep boop. You heard it. Don't lie.

clues.clue: Which park hosted the nighttime parade SpectroMagic from 1991 to 2010?
clues.reveal: Drumroll, please... the correct answer is Magic Kingdom. [laughs] SpectroMagic had fiber optics everywhere, and fans still miss it.

categories.title: Showstoppers
categories.intro: Club DJ wanted stage shows! [excited] These are the live shows where you get to sit down, cool off, and be AMAZED.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: an empty grand theater stage with red velvet curtains opening, spotlights, stage smoke and a huge golden proscenium arch

clues.clue: Animal Kingdom's big in-the-round musical show is called Festival of the Lion King. Which movie is it based on?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Lion King. [sarcastic] Easy one, folks. The title gave it away.

clues.clue: At Hollywood Studios, which film's live stage show features the songs Be Our Guest and Gaston?
accept: beauty and the beast live on stage
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is Beauty and the Beast. [laughs] Live on stage since 1991. No one performs like Gaston.

clues.clue: The Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular recreates scenes from which Indiana Jones film?
accept: indiana jones and the raiders of the lost ark
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Raiders of the Lost Ark. Yes, the giant boulder rolls, and yes, they pick audience members as extras.

clues.clue: In Mickey's PhilharMagic, Donald gets into trouble after taking what from Mickey?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Mickey's sorcerer hat. Donald never learns. Not from Fantasia, not from anything.

clues.clue: Epcot's The American Adventure is hosted by Audio-Animatronic Benjamin Franklin and which famous author?
clues.reveal: [gasps] Oh, this one is TOUGH. The correct answer is... Mark Twain. [mischievously] Ben Franklin even climbs a staircase in that show. Pretty impressive for a robot.
